sentences.text: Researchers investigated whether the requirement for the RIM scaffold protein is uniform across synapses with varying natural release probabilities by using a neurotoxin to block specific nerve inputs in fruit flies.

High-resolution images revealed that RIM sits physically closer to calcium channels at the high-probability synapse, where it is strictly necessary for both rapid signal transmission and the rearrangement of channels to increase vesicle readiness, whereas it is not needed for slow adjustments or at the nearby low-probability synapse.

The authors conclude that the necessity of RIM depends on both the synapse type and the nature of the long-term change, as it is required for rapid adjustments at high-probability sites but not for slow adjustments at low-probability sites.
